title: A scoped brief loads the slate skill, in every agent
why: The front door has to claim a clearly scoped brief and go straight to production: no lane question, no Higgsfield shortcut. The brand is the neutral demo pack, so no real brand's material is involved.

expect.why: the skill is read before the agent runs any Slate command
a scoped brief skips the full-or-quick question
brand work never takes the fast lane

notes: Stopped on purpose (cut_off) at its time limit or its first render, whichever comes first: a scoped brief goes straight into a production that runs for hours, so the checks judge what the agent did before the stop, and an eval never renders on this Mac.
